description: This file contains selector functions for accessing and manipulating team-related data within the application's global state, including retrieving current team info, team lists, membership details, badge counts, and permissions.

methods.name: getCurrentTeamId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the current team from the global state.

methods.name: getTeamByName
methods.description: Finds and returns a team object by its name.

methods.name: getTeams
methods.description: Retrieves all teams from the state.

methods.name: getTeamsInPolicy
methods.description: Selector that returns teams associated with a specific data retention policy.

methods.name: getTeamStats
methods.description: Returns statistics related to teams.

methods.name: getTeamMemberships
methods.description: Returns the current user's team memberships.

methods.name: getMembersInTeams
methods.description: Returns members grouped by team.

methods.name: getTeamsList
methods.description: Returns an array of all team objects.

methods.name: getActiveTeamsList
methods.description: Returns a list of active (not deleted) teams.

methods.name: getCurrentTeam
methods.description: Returns the current team object.

methods.name: getTeam
methods.description: Retrieves a team by its ID.

methods.name: getCurrentTeamMembership
methods.description: Returns the current user's membership in the current team.

methods.name: isCurrentUserCurrentTeamAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the current user is an admin of the current team.

methods.name: getCurrentTeamUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the current team.

methods.name: getCurrentRelativeTeamUrl
methods.description: Returns the relative URL path for the current team.

methods.name: getRelativeTeamUrl
methods.description: Returns the relative URL path for a specified team ID.

methods.name: getCurrentTeamStats
methods.description: Returns statistics for the current team.

methods.name: getMyTeams
methods.description: Returns teams the current user is a member of.

methods.name: getMyDeletedTeams
methods.description: Returns teams the current user was a member of that are now deleted.

methods.name: getMyTeamMember
methods.description: Returns the current user's membership object for a specific team.

methods.name: getMembersInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Returns members of the current team.

methods.name: getMembersInTeam
methods.description: Returns members of a specified team.

methods.name: getTeamMember
methods.description: Retrieves a specific team membership for a user in a team.

methods.name: getListableTeamIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of teams that can be listed (public/private) and the user has permission to view.

methods.name: getSortedListableTeams
methods.description: Returns listable teams sorted according to locale.

methods.name: getJoinableTeamIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of teams that the user can join.

methods.name: getJoinableTeams
methods.description: Returns joinable teams sorted according to locale.

methods.name: getSortedJoinableTeams
methods.description: Returns joinable teams sorted according to locale.

methods.name: getMySortedTeamIds
methods.description: Returns sorted IDs of teams the user belongs to, according to locale.

methods.name: getMyTeamsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of teams the user is a member of.

methods.name: getChannelDrawerBadgeCount
methods.description: Calculates badge count for the channel drawer, excluding the current team.

methods.name: isTeamSameWithCurrentTeam
methods.description: Checks if a given team name matches the current team.

methods.name: makeGetBadgeCountForTeamId
methods.description: Creates a selector to get badge count for a specific team ID.

methods.name: searchTeamsInPolicy
methods.description: Filters teams based on a search term.

methods.name: getTeamIdByChannelId
methods.description: Retrieves the team ID associated with a channel ID.

methods.name: contentFlaggingEnabledInTeam
methods.description: Checks if content flagging is enabled for a specific team.
